C1451.title: Solidity Smart Contract Timestamp Manipulation Vulnerability and Fix
C1451.summary: A lottery contract nearly lost $50,000 due to using block.timestamp to control the drawing logic. A malicious miner could manipulate the block timestamp within a roughly 900-second window to select themselves as the winner. The article provides secure alternatives, such as using a longer time window and a more secure randomness source.

references.title: Fix Smart Contract Timestamp Attacks in 20 Minutes (Before You Lose Money)
